TickerASX ticker ASX code. Click to open the related deep-dive page where available.CommodityPrimary commodity tag The first commodity tag in the target universe — the commodity the ticker is most aligned with for benchmarking purposes.StageLife-cycle stage Explorer (no revenue, drilling), Developer (capex phase, building), or Producer (revenue-generating mine). Different forecast models apply per stage — forecasting revenue growth on a pre-revenue explorer is meaningless.P/ETrailing Price / Earnings Share price ÷ trailing 12-month earnings per share. Lower = cheaper per dollar of recent profit. Null for loss-making companies (most ASX explorers). ↑P/BPrice / Book value Share price ÷ book value per share. Lower = trading closer to net asset value. Most universally populated of the four ratios.P/SPrice / Sales Market cap ÷ trailing 12-month revenue. Lower = cheaper relative to top line. Null for pre-revenue explorers.P/CFsparse — operating cash-flow coverage limitedPrice / operating cash flow Market cap ÷ the latest annual net operating cash flow. Only populated when the latest annual operating cash flow is positive, so this column is intentionally sparse on the current materials universe.PEGPEG ratio Trailing P/E ÷ net-profit CAGR expressed in percentage-point units (15% growth uses 15, not 0.15). Lower = cheaper relative to earnings growth. Null when P/E is non-positive or the ticker lacks enough positive-profit history to compute a positive CAGR.EV/EBITDAEnterprise Value / EBITDA Used as a P/CF proxy because operating cash flow is sparsely reported. Lower = cheaper relative to operating cash generation. Moves with P/CF for asset-heavy industrials but diverges for businesses with large non-cash items.
